segments.sn35.145:1.2: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo rūpānaṃ uppādāya, sopi anattā.
segments.sn35.145:1.3: Anattasambhūtā, bhikkhave, rūpā kuto attā bhavissanti!
segments.sn35.145:1.9: Yopi hetu, yopi paccayo dhammānaṃ uppādāya, sopi anattā.
segments.sn35.145:1.10: Anattasambhūtā, bhikkhave, dhammā kuto attā bhavissanti!
segments.sn35.145:1.11: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpesupi nibbindati, saddesupi … gandhesupi … rasesupi … phoṭṭhabbesupi … dhammesupi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.145:1.12: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn35.145:1.13: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: 137-145. Catutthaṃ suddhikaṃ katvā desiyamāne bujjhanakānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttaṃ.
Pañcamādīni tathā tathā bujjhantānaṃ ajjhāsayena vuttāni.
Tathā tathāti ajjhattikāni bāhirāni ca āyatanāni aniccalakkhaṇena dukkhānattalakkhaṇehi ca yojetvā dassanavasena.
